transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been dealing with really intense mood swings for about a year and a half now. Sometimes I feel incredibly energetic and on top of the world, but then I'll suddenly become extremely irritable and angry over the smallest things. It just feels like my mood and energy are constantly all over the place.

During those high-energy periods, have there been times when you needed much less sleep and still felt fine, or did things like talking faster, having racing thoughts, or doing risky or impulsive things?

I've definitely done some really risky and impulsive things during those times, like going on massive spending sprees I can't afford, making foolish business investments, and engaging in risky sexual behavior. However, I'm not really sure about having racing thoughts or needing less sleep, as I haven't really noticed those.
Have you ever had hallucinations or strong beliefs that others said were not true during times when your mood was otherwise normal, not during a high or depressed episode?
No, I've never experienced anything like hallucinations or strong false beliefs when my mood was normal. Those kinds of things have never happened to me during my stable periods.
During your high-energy periods, did your symptoms ever become severe enough that you were hospitalized, had psychotic symptoms, or caused major problems at work, school, or in relationships?

I've never been hospitalized or had psychotic symptoms, but these high-energy phases have definitely caused major problems in my life. Over the last year and a half, my reckless spending and foolish business investments have caused severe financial distress for me and my family. On top of that, my impulsive behavior and risky sexual indiscretions have put a massive strain on my relationships.
What is the longest one of these high-energy periods has lasted, from start to finish? Has any one lasted at least 4 days, or at least 1 week?
Yes, they last much longer than just a week. In fact, these high-energy periods and behaviors have been going on pretty much continuously for about a year and a half now.
Have you also had separate periods of depression lasting at least 2 weeks, where you felt down most of the day or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

No, I haven't really experienced those kinds of depressive periods or lost interest in things. My struggles have been almost entirely with those high-energy and irritable phases rather than feeling down.
